source_title: FHA Single Family Housing Policy Handbook 4000.1
note: Paraphrased rule records for the FHA Golden Loan Path. Every record carries underwriting_method: 'total' (II.A.4, TOTAL Mortgage Scorecard) or 'manual' (II.A.5, Manual Underwriting). Where the Handbook states the same rule in both sections, both versions are preserved as separate records bound to their own section so the TOTAL text can never be applied to a manual file and vice versa. Anchors must exist in the privately cached official slice for the regression step to pass. Rule records are versioned: each record binds to one Handbook version (section key <number>@update-17 or @update-18, rule_id suffixed the same way); the effective-date resolver (sources.resolve_rule) picks the version in force on the relevant date (FHA: case number assignment date; Update 18 may be implemented early but is mandatory from 11/10/2026).

rules.text: Documents used in origination and underwriting may not be more than 120 Days old at the Disbursement Date (appraisals have their own validity period; documents unaffected by time such as divorce decrees or tax returns may be older). Day one is the day after the document's effective or issue date.
rules.anchor: more than 120 Days old at the Disbursement Date

rules.text: Traditional current employment documentation (Update 17, in force): the most recent pay stub and a written Verification of Employment (VOE) covering two years, or direct electronic verification of employment by a TPV vendor covering two years; Reverification of employment within 10 Days prior to the Note date. Update 18 renames these WVOE/EVOE.
